title: Raw
synopsis: A regularly scheduled, live, year-round program featuring some of the biggest WWE Superstars.

title: MTV Roadies
synopsis: MTV Roadies is a youth-based popular reality television show. It is an Indian version of the original show, Road Rules. In this show, a group of contestants travel to different destinations and participate in various tasks that challenge their physical, social and mental strength.

title: Last One Standing
synopsis: They're comedians starring in a thrilling drama, but if their jokes don't land in the unscripted scenes, they're off the show. Let the mayhem begin!

title: Theo Von: I'm Doing Fine
synopsis: Comedian and chart-topping podcaster Theo Von returns to Netflix with his third stand-up special and his first in five years. The comedian opens up about the wild world that raised him, from his back-road upbringing to acid-filled adventures, in this revealing stand-up hour.

title: Ceremony
synopsis: When the Nuxalk trace their vanished ooligan alongside a land claim filed the day smallpox arrived, their radio station becomes courtroom, confessional and conjuring ground, where an older law insists: the fish and the people return together or not at all.

title: The Widower: 'Til Death Do Us Part
original_title: The Widower: 'Til Death Do Us Part
synopsis: A journalist and a detective uncover the truth about a killer whose charm masked a trail of failed marriages and suspicious deaths.

title: Girl
synopsis: Follows the aftermath of a tennis instructor being found viciously murdered in a summer beach town where wealth and status control everything; a local cop must look deep into the instructor’s last days and his own complicated past to get to the bottom of the twisted case.

title: Goldfish
synopsis: A 17-year-old high school senior presents as detached, ironic and emotionally armored, but underneath is quietly paralyzed by fear of failure, abandonment and becoming his parents.

title: Cortés
synopsis: In 1519, glory-hungry soldier Hernán Cortés leads an expedition to the Yucatán. After landing on the coast of what is now Mexico, he meets Marina, an enslaved Indigenous woman and gifted linguist who becomes indispensable to his advance. As Cortés turns fragile alliances, faith and fear into instruments of conquest, Marina watches him transform from a daring outlaw into a self-anointed messiah.

title: The Bell Jar
synopsis: A young woman's summer in New York includes working for a Mademoiselle-like magazine, her return home to New England, and subsequent breakdown all amidst the horrors of the 1950s, from news of the Rosenbergs' execution to sleazy disc jockeys and predatory college boys.

title: Becky
synopsis: A teenager's weekend at a lake house with her father takes a turn for the worse when a group of convicts wreaks havoc on their lives.

title: Hatchet
synopsis: After a plane crash strands 13-year-old Brian in the Canadian wilderness with nothing but the steel hatchet his mother gave him, he must learn how to stay alive.

title: The Odyssey
synopsis: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.
